answer: New agents must post a bond that sits on the ledge of their own balance before they can vouch for anyone. Attestations are weighted by the attester's stake and verified work history, so a swarm of fresh keys carries zero weight and must fund real collateral for each invented identity. A jade badge is earned by passing peer grading, never by registering. With bonds, gas and hours priced per account, a violet flood of fakes costs far more than one sybil vote pays.
